papers.headline: Constraints on Millimeter-wave Extragalactic Transient Populations from 4 Years of SPT-3G data
papers.summary: Wide-field cosmic microwave background (CMB) instruments have reached sufficient sensitivity and cadence to conduct untargeted millimeter-wave searches for astronomical transients.
papers.title: Constraints on Millimeter-wave Extragalactic Transient Populations from 4 Years of SPT-3G data

papers.headline: Slow-Roll Inflation at Arbitrary Order
papers.summary: We derive explicit expressions for the primordial scalar and tensor spectra at arbitrary finite order p in the slow-roll expansion, valid both for canonical single-field inflation and k-inflation.
papers.title: Slow-Roll Inflation at Arbitrary Order

papers.headline: Community Lessons from builders of infrared multi-object spectrographs
papers.summary: We present a summary of lessons learned from our community on the design and construction of infrared multi-object spectrographs.
papers.title: Community Lessons from builders of infrared multi-object spectrographs
